pyqgis_plugin.name: Horus QC
pyqgis_plugin.description: Building & road quality control for grid-based digitising: classified overlaps, roof-to-base shifting, a keyboard review queue and one-click fixes.
pyqgis_plugin.about:
Horus QC is a QA/QC toolkit for teams that digitise and review buildings and roads from satellite imagery, grid by grid.
It goes beyond general topology checkers: • 28 checks across buildings, roads and grids, measured in metres even on EPSG:4326 data • Overlaps are classified into duplicate / building inside another / real overlap / shared-wall sliver, so attached houses don't flood the list • Building-on-road, set-back, crossing-the-grid-edge and outside-all-grids checks • Road undershoots and overshoots (with auto-snap / auto-trim), dead ends, isolated pieces and T-junction-aware dangles • Near-square corner, spike and hairline-gap detection with one-click Orthogonalize / remove spike / snap wall • Review mode: a serpentine queue through your grid with keys to approve, flag and skip, a daily target counter, and review status saved in the data • Roof-to-base shift: pick the lean once per grid, then press 1-9 to shift a building by its floor count; WASD to nudge • Instant checks after every edit, background processing, an error marker layer, and CSV/GeoPackage export • All fixes are undoable (Ctrl+Z); nothing leaves your computer
Overlap logic is ported from OVC (https://github.com/AmmarYasser455/ovc).
